answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. The mirror of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The ocean is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nadir. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
